newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cenbank urges greater fiscal adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cenbank urges greater fiscal adjustment.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 2 Reuter - Colombia's central bank called on the government to make further fiscal adjustments in the face of what it called a "worrying outlook" for long term growth and stability, in a report sent to Congress Wednesday.

"The fiscal figures and new developments in foreign trade show a worrying outlook for long term stability and growth in the economy, which therefore requires greater fiscal efforts than those already carried out," the report said.
